test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

A good breakfast __give very energy__ needed by you.
solution:
The correct answer is **'gives all the energy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When we read the given sentence we get to know a few important things:
 
 
• First of all, the sentence is in present indefinite tense.
 
• **The subject 'A good breakfast' is singular.**
 
• In the present indefinite tense, **if the subject is singular, we generally use verb 1st for form with 's/es'.**
 
• So the sentence should be* 'A good breakfast gives all the energy needed by you'.*
 
 
 
• Hence the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the concept with **some more examples:**

 
 
• **Success needs** strong willpower and consistent efforts.
 
• **Only a regular workout shows** the result in your physique.
